title: Outcome-independent DrivAerML-to-SHIFT-SUV morphology relation
scientific_question: Is the DrivAerML source morphology measurably closer to SHIFT-SUV estate or fastback vehicles before source-initialization benefits are revealed?
role: This is an independent test of the geometry-scaffold rival, not a surrogate-accuracy result.

allowed: the frozen SHIFT-SUV train_128 geometry subsets

descriptor: area-weighted 5th-to-95th percentile span along the freestream-aligned x, y, and z axes
upper triangle of the area-weighted centroid second-moment matrix
upper triangle of the area-weighted surface-normal second-moment matrix
geometry_measurement.intentional_noninvariance: The common freestream-aligned axes are retained because longitudinal, lateral, and vertical morphology have different physical roles.

analysis.standardization: Use the 435 averaged DrivAerML descriptors to center and scale every feature; drop only features with source standard deviation below 1e-8.
analysis.distance: Euclidean energy distance in the standardized descriptor space.

bootstrap.resampling: resample source, estate, and fastback cases independently; use the same source resample for both distances

validity_gates.case_identity: All three consumed case sets and manifest hashes must exactly match this preregistration.
validity_gates.sampling_stability: Within every domain, the median relative L2 difference between the two per-case descriptor passes must be at most 5%, and the 95th percentile at most 15%.
validity_gates.direction_stability: The two sampling passes must give the same source-to-family distance ordering as the averaged descriptors.
validity_gates.no_test_access: Only the three declared training case sets may be loaded.

decision_rule.decisive_morphology_ordering: Name one target family as closer only if all validity gates pass, the paired-bootstrap 95% interval for the primary contrast excludes zero, and the farther-to-nearer point distance ratio is at least 1.10.
decision_rule.otherwise: Record that this descriptor provides no decisive morphology ordering; do not retrofit another geometry metric after viewing adaptation outcomes.

joint_prediction_for_the_adaptation_pilo.geometry_scaffold: If a closer family is established, its geometric-mean same-budget pretraining gain should exceed the farther family's by at least 10% for both architectures.
joint_prediction_for_the_adaptation_pilo.falsifier: A decisive morphology ordering with the opposite transfer ordering in either architecture rejects morphology proximity as a sufficient explanation of the pilot effect.
joint_prediction_for_the_adaptation_pilo.limit: Agreement is directional support only. This descriptor is not the model's learned representation, and DrivAerML-to-SHIFT-SUV also changes flow regime.
